summary: Iteration 14 · Tested 3 new features end-to-end: (1) Free 90-day broker audit landing (/audit/broker-free, /free-audit alias), (2) Auto-generated audit PDFs (data-checklist, playbook, data-request-letter, engagement-agreement) + /audit/playbook hub, (3) Outreach campaigns admin tab with 5 templates + render + log tracker. Backend pytest 12/12 passing. Frontend all critical flows verified via Playwright. 0 critical issues.

integration_issues.flow: Admin deep-link /admin?tab=outreach when not logged in
integration_issues.issue: After /admin?tab=outreach prompts the OPEN THE VAULT login, the post-login redirect drops the ?tab=outreach query so user lands on default LEADS tab. Tab still reachable via the OUTREACH CAMPAIGNS tab button. Minor UX issue, not blocking.

action_items: (Nice-to-have, not blocking) Preserve ?tab= query param across the admin login redirect so deep-links like /admin?tab=outreach land on the right tab after OPEN THE VAULT.
critical_code_review_comments: audit_playbook.py is clean, well-structured, four PDFs each via reportlab. All 4 routes return proper application/pdf with %PDF magic header and >1KB content.

outreach_campaigns.py · template render uses regex {{\s*[\w_]+\s*}} with passthrough on undeclared vars — verified consulting_upsell leaves {{score}}/{{tier}} intact when omitted (good for visibility).
Outreach log uses uuid.uuid4().hex[:16] for IDs · 16 hex chars = 64-bit space which is fine for an operator-internal log; not collision-proof at scale but acceptable for v1.

Server registration order is correct: audit_playbook (api4) included BEFORE consulting_audit (api3) so /api/audit/{filename}.pdf is not consumed by /api/audit/{audit_id} catchall — verified all 4 PDFs return 200.

Admin endpoints /api/admin/outreach/* are NOT auth-gated server-side (works without bearer token). Per agent_to_agent_context_note this is by design for v1; should be tightened before any non-operator usage.
seed_data_creation: Test data prefixed with TEST_ inserted: 1 audit doc (TEST_Bay_and_Bay_Brokers, lead_magnet=free_90_day) + 4 outreach_log rows (TEST_Dana, TEST_DanaUI). Cleanup not performed — operator can delete via admin tracker DEL buttons.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration14_audit_outreach.py is a self-contained regression suite — covers 4 PDF endpoints, /api/audit/start with lead_magnet, /api/outreach/campaigns (5 templates), /api/outreach/render (substitution + passthrough), /api/outreach/log, /api/admin/outreach/log (list + patch). Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/test_iteration14_audit_outreach.py -v. NOTE the industry id is 'freight_brokerage' (not 'freight_broker') and StartBody uses 'company_name' + 'fleet_or_team_size' field names. UI flows verified live: /audit/broker-free hero + form + redirect, /audit/playbook 4 PDF cards, /free-audit alias, admin OUTREACH CAMPAIGNS tab with render + log-send + tracker.
rca of the issue: No real bugs. One UX nit: ?tab= query param is dropped by admin login redirect (LoginGate handler probably uses navigate('/admin') instead of preserving location). Not blocking — the OUTREACH CAMPAIGNS tab button works.
